workarounds.symptom: [FR] Log a per-scorer error count in mlflow.genai.evaluate() run metrics
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Log a per-scorer error count in `mlflow.genai.evaluate()` run metrics. Target files: mlflow/genai/evaluation/harness.py, mlflow/genai/scorers/aggregation.py, tests/genai/evaluate/test_evaluation.py. `mlflow.genai.evaluate()` now logs `<scorer>/error_count` for each scorer that failed at least once. Before this change, a scorer that failed on some rows logged a mean over the rows that worked, with no sign of the failures, and a scorer that failed on every row logged no metric at all. (Ref: https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow/pull/27504)

workarounds.symptom: [BUG] Claude Code plugin: spans never reach the SQL spans table on OSS servers (empty cost charts); async mode drops traces (Cannot find module '@mlflow/core/package.json')
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Ship the WAL daemon inside @mlflow/claude-code. Target files: libs/typescript/core/src/core/provider.ts, libs/typescript/core/src/exporters/wal/supervisor.ts, libs/typescript/integrations/claude-code/package.json. Plugin-marketplace installs ship only bundle/*.cjs with no node_modules, so resolveDaemonEntry()'s runtime lookup of @mlflow/core/package.json always fails and async trace uploads are silently dropped (#26833).
